# dnsgate_teams (Data Source)

The teams of the gate policy (`GET /api/v1/teams`). Teams own RRsets; the gate declares them with their members in its policy. Empty, with a warning, on gates without teams.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dnsgate_teams" "declared" {
  kind = "declared"
}

output "teams" {
  value = { for t in data.dnsgate_teams.declared.teams : t.name => t.description }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `kind` (String) Keep only the teams of this kind: `declared` (teams block of the gate configuration or of its managed policy), `auto` (named by a binding or a virtual key without being declared, during the migration to the teams block), `family` (teams derived from a claim by `team_from`, name `<prefix>*`), `claim` (teams taken from the `team_claim` of an issuer, name `*`), `store` (owns RRsets but named nowhere in the policy).

### Read-Only

- `names` (List of String) Names of the teams, sorted.
- `strict` (Boolean) Whether the gate requires every team named by its policy to be declared (its configuration has a `teams` block).
- `teams` (Attributes List) Teams sorted by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--teams))

<a id="nestedatt--teams"></a>
### Nested Schema for `teams`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String)
- `family` (Attributes) Derivation of a `family` team, null otherwise. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--teams--family))
- `issuer` (String) Issuer of a `claim` team.
- `kind` (String) Where the team comes from: `declared` (teams block of the gate configuration or of its managed policy), `auto` (named by a binding or a virtual key without being declared, during the migration to the teams block), `family` (teams derived from a claim by `team_from`, name `<prefix>*`), `claim` (teams taken from the `team_claim` of an issuer, name `*`), `store` (owns RRsets but named nowhere in the policy).
- `layer` (String) `base` (gate configuration file) or `managed` (managed policy) for declared teams, empty otherwise.
- `members` (Attributes) Members of a declared team. Null unless the identity holds `policy.read` in the gate, and for teams that are not declared. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--teams--members))
- `name` (String) Team name.
- `roles` (List of String) Roles of the bindings and virtual keys naming the team.
- `virtual_keys` (List of String) Virtual keys acting for the team.
- `warning` (String) Why the gate flags the team (for example undeclared), empty otherwise.

<a id="nestedatt--teams--family"></a>
### Nested Schema for `teams.family`

Read-Only:

- `claim` (String)
- `prefix` (String)
- `regex` (String)

### Nested Schema for `teams.members`

Read-Only:

- `subjects` (Attributes List) Subject matchers: an issuer and the claims a token must carry. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--teams--members--subjects))
